falsification_conditions.condition: The tracked benchmark (BTC if crypto-led, else SPX) posts a daily close at least 12% below the lowest daily close inside the current bottom_2022_may_luna pattern window within 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The May-2022 local-bottom analog is a continuation breakdown, not an unconfirmed base, so HOLD/UNKNOWN is the wrong call.

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 75 on any session in the next 14 days while that same benchmark closes at least 8% above the pattern-window high.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Regime is a blow-off advance, not a Luna-style capitulation bottom, so the UNKNOWN bottom-watch and HOLD are invalidated.

falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern similarity to bottom_2022_may_luna falls to 50% or below on the engine's own match score before day 14, and stays at or below 50% on the day-14 reading.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 79% bottom analog no longer holds, so a verdict that rests on that pattern match is false.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
